ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy via ERC-777 callback during swap to read stale reserves (Bunni/Curve $81M pattern)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags blocks all re-entry. _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) preserves ENTERED bit (line 68-71). All entry points (singleSwap, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, collectFees) use nonReentrantWithFlags. View functions (getPoolState) return consistent post-update state during callbacks.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Read-only reentrancy via token transfer callback observing partially-updated state ($86M cumulative pattern)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: StateObserverToken (ERC-777 style) reads getPoolState() during transfer. Observed reserves are consistent with post-swap state. Reserves are updated atomically before the output transfer in _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse. No stale read possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient storage stale value between two swaps in same TX (SIR protocol $355K pattern)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Two swaps in the same TX with different amounts: second swap's beforeSwap correctly overwrites the transient slot. Also tested: revert in first swap does NOT leave dirty transient storage (EIP-1153 spec mandates tstore reverts on revert).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cross-component settings change mid-TX creating desync (Cork protocol $12M pattern)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Settings changes between swaps in the same TX are correctly read fresh by the second swap. Token settings are stored in persistent storage (not cached), so each swap reads the current settings. No stale cache vector.

_collectToken (AMMModule.sol:2917) has balance before/after check that reverts on FOT tokens (LBAMM__TokenInTransferFailed). Swap path also protected at line 2208. Both addLiquidity and swap revert on FOT tokens.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Multi-swap transient slot overwrite between pool swaps
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: multiSwap processes pools sequentially. Transient storage is per-swap scoped: beforeSwap writes, afterSwap reads, then next swap starts fresh. No cross-pool contamination.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Native ETH refund reentrancy to observe intermediate state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess sends ETH refund via low-level call. Reentrancy guard (ENTERED bit) is active during the refund callback. All state-changing entry points revert on re-entry. View functions return consistent state.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CLOB settlement callback reads AMM state before swap finalizes
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBTransferHandler.ammHandleTransfer operates on CLOB's own state (order book). It does not read AMM reserves or pool state. The handler receives explicit amounts from the AMM and processes settlement independently.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan profit extraction via addLiquidity/swap/removeLiquidity sequence
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Round-trip flash loan tests consistently show attacker loses money due to swap fees. Fuzz-tested with 25 random amounts. No profitable sequence found.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cross-pool arbitrage value leak between Dynamic and Fixed pool types
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Large swap in one pool shifts price. Attempting arbitrage on second pool for same pair results in loss (fees consumed exceed any price differential profit).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Reentrancy during _executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers to corrupt fee state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) at line 3190 clears custom flags but preserves ENTERED bit. All entry points (singleSwap, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, collectProtocolFees) revert on re-entry attempts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust accumulation via 100-swap loop extracting rounding errors
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: 100-swap loop test shows zero dust accumulation. Attacker loses money on every swap due to fees. Rounding favors the protocol (truncation toward zero output).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Diamond storage slot collision between AMMModule and pool types
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule has zero storage slots (confirmed via Slither get_storage_layout). All storage accessed via LBAMMStorage at slot 0x9A1D. Pool types are external contracts (not modules), so no slot collision possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: View function during swap sees inconsistent state via forged hook caller
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook callbacks require _requireCallerIsAMM() check. External contracts cannot impersonate the AMM address. Forged hook calls revert.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial state write interleaving between add liquidity and swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: addLiquidity + swap in same TX: state is fully committed after addLiquidity returns (no partial writes). Subsequent swap reads correct post-liquidity state.
